name: Sant Celoni (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with a cross with a red vertical arm and a yellow horizontal arm, itself charged with a smaller cross with a white vertical arm and a black horizontal arm.
history: The flag was published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 5 June 1991; it is defined as an oblong flag of 2:3, blue, charged at the centre with a cross whose vertical arm is red and horizontal arm yellow, both one third of the height wide, in turn charged with another cross with a white vertical and black horizontal arm.
